messages.subject: as.matrix.cast_matrix strips identifiers
parts:
I am using reshape to prepare some data for use with the Bioconductor
package.
I am using melt and then cast to produce a data frame with the format
I want.
I then converted the data frame to a matrix in order to create a
Bioconductor ExpressionSet
When I attempt to create the ExpressionSet I get an error indicating
that Bioconductor cannot work with an object of the class
cast_matrix. I then used the method "as.matrix.cast_matrix" to
convert the cast_matrix into a matrix and I am able to create the
Bioconductor ExpressionSet.

My problem is that when I use "as.matrix.cast_matrix" I lose the row
names and column names. Is there a way to use as.matrix.cast_matrix
and maintain these identifiers?

Thanks, Doug B
